description:
Run an on-device translation API on your Mac for Immersive Translate and other compatible clients. Apple Translation converts English into Simplified Chinese, with offline translation after the language packs are downloaded.

• Start and stop the local service and see its running status.
• Copy the API address and follow the in-app Immersive Translate setup steps.
• Prepare English and Simplified Chinese language packs in the app.
• The API binds only to 127.0.0.1, with a configurable port and no API key.
• The service continues when the window is closed. Reopen it from the Window menu, Command-0, the status-bar icon, or the Dock.
• Login startup is optional and off by default.
• No accounts, ads, or translation history. The app does not upload source or translated text.

Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 26.4 or later. The first-version interface is in Simplified Chinese. To connect Immersive Translate, enable Beta features in the extension's developer settings, select its custom API service, and enter the address shown by the app.
promotionalText: Start a local translation service on your Mac, copy its address, and connect Immersive Translate with guided setup.
